name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: A row of buttons that each stay pressed or not, any number at a time, such as the days an alarm repeats on, as the round weekday buttons of the iOS Clock app.
docs: Import as `import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/toggle-group'`. See https://plexui.com/vue/components/toggle-group for props and examples.
